faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about GreenRoot internships.

items.question: Who can apply for GreenRoot internships?
items.answer: Any agriculture student or recent graduate from India can apply. We welcome students from all agricultural disciplines including Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Agricultural Engineering, and more.

items.question: Which countries offer internship opportunities?
items.answer: We currently offer internships in Denmark, Germany, USA, Israel, Australia, Canada, Italy, Portugal, and Peru. We are actively expanding to more countries.

items.question: How do I apply for an internship?
items.answer: Create your profile, complete all mandatory details, browse available internships, and submit your application through our simple 5-step process. Our team will guide you through every stage.

items.question: What documents are required to apply?
items.answer: You will need your passport, Aadhaar card, PAN card, academic transcripts, resume/CV, and a statement of purpose. Specific programmes may require additional documents which will be clearly listed.
